data.name: POST MODERN MUSIC SHOWCASE
data.description:
Post Modern Music Showcase - Bangalore 

Post Modern Music has spent years carving out its own space in electronic music, with a catalogue that moves between the experimental, the ambient and the downright unconventional. Their sound has never been about sticking to a formula, and their contribution to the scene goes well beyond the music itself.

From the artists they've championed to the sounds they've brought into the world, PMM has been part of shaping how electronic music continues to evolve, across borders and beyond genres.

On November 13, we're dedicating a night to Post Modern Music, the artists behind it, and everything their music stands for.

📍 GYLT | Bengaluru

data.name: Halloween Special Ft. Yara - Deviant Force Label Showcase Goa
data.description:
For twenty years, Yara has crafted a unique sonic identity defined by intricate rhythms, layered atmospheres and driving intensity.

This Halloween season, the celebration comes to Goa.

Originally from Venezuela, Savina Scattaglia, known by the artist name Yara, began her musical journey in the ’90s, pioneering the local scene through Psykomunity before moving into live performances and original productions. From Venezuela to Spain and now Brazil, her music has evolved across cultures while staying rooted in experimentation and her distinct approach to trance.

Yara returns to Goa as part of her first dedicated India tour, marking her 20-year milestone with a night dedicated to the lush sounds of Deviant Force Records.

Joining her is Karran Khanna, a homegrown veteran and fellow Deviant Force Records artist, bringing his own experience and distinct sound to the dance floor.

Gabba enters the sonic journey with dark frequencies and hypnotic soundscapes, taking the experience into deeper, more untamed territories.

Dive into original productions, immersive textures and relentless rhythms. 
Three artists. One dance floor. More artists to be announced.

This Halloween, we have more than one reason to come together. 

Goa, see you on the dance floor.

📅 Sunday, 1 November 2026
📍 Ocean Pirates Cafe, Anjuna, Goa

Artwork: @delusive_illusion_by_psynstein

Organised by: @pulsesociety
